text_target: I live with my mom and my younger brother.
phonetic: /aɪ lɪv wɪð maɪ mɒm ænd maɪ ˈjʌŋɡər ˈbrʌðər/
text_native: Je vis avec ma mère et mon petit frère.

text_target: My grandparents stay just down the street from us.
phonetic: /maɪ ˈɡrændpeərənts steɪ dʒʌst daʊn ðə striːt frɒm ʌs/
text_native: Mes grands-parents habitent juste en bas de chez nous.

text_target: We usually visit our cousins during the summer break.
phonetic: /wiː ˈjuːʒuəli ˈvɪzɪt ˈaʊə ˈkʌzɪnz ˈdjʊərɪŋ ðə ˈsʌmər breɪk/
text_native: On va généralement rendre visite à nos cousins pendant les vacances d'été.

text_target: My older sister is studying graphic design at university.
phonetic: /maɪ ˈəʊldər ˈsɪstər ɪz ˈstʌdiɪŋ ˈɡræfɪk dɪˈzaɪn æt ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/
text_native: Ma grande sœur fait des études de design graphique à l'université.

text_target: Who do you look like more in your family?
phonetic: /huː duː juː lʊk laɪk mɔːr ɪn jɔːr ˈfæməli/
text_native: Tu ressembles le plus à qui dans ta famille ?

text_target: My dad loves cooking big dinners for everybody on Sundays.
phonetic: /maɪ dæd lʌvz ˈkʊkɪŋ bɪɡ ˈdɪnərz fɔːr ˈevribɒdi ɒn ˈsʌndeɪz/
text_native: Mon père adore cuisiner de grands repas pour tout le monde le dimanche.

text_target: I share a bedroom with my twin brother, which can be noisy.
phonetic: /aɪ ʃeər ə ˈbedruːm wɪð maɪ twɪn ˈbrʌðər, wɪtʃ kæn biː ˈnɔɪzi/
text_native: Je partage ma chambre avec mon frère jumeau, ce qui peut être bruyant.

text_target: My aunt works as a nurse in the city center hospital.
phonetic: /maɪ ɑːnt wɜːks æz ə nɜːs ɪn ðə ˈsɪti ˈsentər ˈhɒspɪtl/
text_native: Ma tante travaille comme infirmière dans l'hôpital du centre-ville.

text_target: We always celebrate our wedding anniversary by going out for dinner.
phonetic: /wiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈselɪbreɪt ˈaʊə ˈwedɪŋ ˌænɪˈvɜːsəri baɪ ˈɡəʊɪŋ aʊt fɔːr ˈdɪnər/
text_native: On fête toujours notre anniversaire de mariage en allant dîner au restaurant.

text_target: My best friend has been by my side since primary school.
phonetic: /maɪ best frend hæz biːn baɪ maɪ saɪd sɪns ˈpraɪməri skuːl/
text_native: Mon meilleur ami est là pour moi depuis l'école primaire.

text_target: Do you get along well with your coworkers?
phonetic: /duː juː ɡet əˈlɒŋ wel wɪð jɔːr ˈkəʊwɜːkərz/
text_native: Tu t'entends bien avec tes collègues ?

text_target: I had a small argument with my roommate about the housework.
phonetic: /aɪ hæd ə smɔːl ˈɑːɡjumənt wɪð maɪ ˈruːmmeɪt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈhaʊswɜːk/
text_native: J'ai eu une petite dispute avec mon colocataire à propos du ménage.

text_target: We usually hang out at the coffee shop after class.
phonetic: /wiː ˈjuːʒuəli hæŋ aʊt æt ðə ˈkɒfi ʃɒp ˈɑːftər klɑːs/
text_native: On passe généralement du temps au café après les cours.

text_target: My uncle told me some hilarious stories about when he was young.
phonetic: /maɪ ˈʌŋkl təʊld miː sʌm hɪˈleəriəs ˈstɔːriz əˈbaʊt wen hiː wɒz jʌŋ/
text_native: Mon oncle m'a raconté des histoires hilarantes sur sa jeunesse.

text_target: It is not always easy to stay in touch when people move away.
phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nɒt ˈɔːlweɪz ˈiːzi tuː steɪ ɪn tʌtʃ wen ˈpiːpl muːv əˈweɪ/
text_native: Ce n'est pas toujours facile de garder contact quand les gens déménagent.

text_target: My neighbor helped me carry heavy boxes into my new apartment.
phonetic: /maɪ ˈneɪbər helpt miː ˈkæri ˈhevi ˈbɒksɪz ˈɪntuː maɪ njuː əˈpɑːtmənt/
text_native: Mon voisin m'a aidé à porter de lourds cartons dans mon nouvel appartement.

text_target: She decided to break up with her boyfriend after three years together.
phonetic: /ʃiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː breɪk ʌp wɪð hɜːr ˈbɔɪfrend ˈɑːftər θriː jɪəz təˈɡeðər/
text_native: Elle a décidé de rompre avec son petit ami après trois ans passés ensemble.

text_target: I met my partner through mutual friends at a birthday party.
phonetic: /aɪ met maɪ ˈpɑːtnər θruː ˈmjuːtʃuəl frendz æt ə ˈbɜːrdeɪ ˈpɑːti/
text_native: J'ai rencontré mon conjoint par des amis communs lors d'une fête d'anniversaire.

text_target: We are organizing a surprise gathering for our parents' fortieth wedding anniversary.
phonetic: /wiː ɑːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzɪŋ ə səˈpraɪz ˈɡæðərɪŋ fɔːr ˈaʊə ˈpeərənts ˈfɔːtiəθ ˈwedɪŋ ˌænɪˈvɜːsəri/
text_native: On organise une fête surprise pour les quarante ans de mariage de nos parents.

text_target: True friendship means supporting each other through difficult times.
phonetic: /truː ˈfrendʃɪp miːnz səˈpɔːtɪŋ iːtʃ ˈʌðər ˈdjʊərɪŋ ˈdɪfɪkəlt taɪmz/
text_native: La vraie amitié signifie se soutenir mutuellement pendant les moments difficiles.
